pages.title: A snowflake at the window
lines: A snowflake comes to Gail.
pages.translation: 一片雪花來到瑜瑜身邊。

pages.title: Before winter
lines: The snowflake opens a door.
pages.translation: 雪花打開一道門。

pages.title: The last warm days
lines: The town gets ready.
pages.translation: 小鎮在準備。

pages.title: A full orchard
lines: The trees have fruit.
pages.translation: 樹上有水果。

pages.title: Pick with care
lines: They pick ripe apples.
pages.translation: 孩子們摘成熟的蘋果。

pages.title: Bring in the crop
lines: A cart takes food home.
pages.translation: 木車把食物運回去。

pages.title: Grapes for the adults
lines: They gather grapes.
pages.translation: 孩子們收集葡萄。

pages.title: Press and seal
lines: Adults make wine. Gail makes juice.
pages.translation: 大人釀酒。瑜瑜做果汁。

pages.title: Eat now or save?
lines: Two baskets hold the fruit.
pages.translation: 兩個籃子裝著水果。

pages.title: Dry the fruit
lines: Fruit dries on a tray.
pages.translation: 水果放在托盤上晾乾。

pages.title: Fill the jars
lines: They fill clean jars.
pages.translation: 鄰居們裝滿乾淨的罐子。

pages.title: Shelves for winter
lines: Gail sets down a jar.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜放下一個罐子。

pages.title: Check the house
lines: The window has a gap.
pages.translation: 窗戶有一條縫。

pages.title: Wood for warmth
lines: The adults stack wood.
pages.translation: 大人堆放木柴。

pages.title: An empty shelf
lines: One neighbor needs food.
pages.translation: 一位鄰居需要食物。

pages.title: Share the harvest
lines: The town shares food.
pages.translation: 小鎮分享食物。

pages.title: One last check
lines: They check the town again.
pages.translation: 他們再次檢查小鎮。

pages.title: The first flake
lines: One snowflake lands.
pages.translation: 一片雪花落下。

pages.title: Ready together
lines: Everyone has a warm place.
pages.translation: 每個人都有溫暖的地方。

pages.title: A promise to return
lines: Gail goes home.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜回家了。

pages.title: A snowflake at the window
lines: One snowflake drifts to Gail’s window.
It rests on the ledge.
pages.translation: 一片雪花飄到瑜瑜的窗邊。|它停在窗沿。

pages.title: Before winter
lines: The still snowflake begins to glow.
Gail sees a town without snow.
pages.translation: 停穩的雪花開始發光。|瑜瑜看見一座還沒下雪的小鎮。

pages.title: The last warm days
lines: Gail reaches the town square.
People are preparing for winter.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜來到鎮上的廣場。|人們正在準備過冬。

pages.title: A full orchard
lines: Gail visits the orchard with a friend.
Ripe apples hang from the trees.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜和朋友走進果園。|成熟的蘋果掛在樹上。

pages.title: Pick with care
lines: The children pick ripe apples gently.
They place each one in a basket.
pages.translation: 孩子們輕輕摘下成熟蘋果。|孩子們把蘋果放進籃子。

pages.title: Bring in the crop
lines: A farmer brings the last crop to the storehouse.
The cart moves slowly.
pages.translation: 農夫把最後的收成運往倉房。|木車慢慢前進。

pages.title: Grapes for the adults
lines: The children collect whole grapes.
They give the baskets to the adults.
pages.translation: 孩子們收集完整的葡萄。|孩子們把籃子交給大人。

pages.title: Press and seal
lines: Adults press grapes and seal a wine barrel.
Gail makes grape juice at another table.
pages.translation: 大人壓葡萄並封好酒桶。|瑜瑜在另一張桌上做葡萄汁。

pages.title: Eat now or save?
lines: One basket is for today.
The other is for winter.
pages.translation: 一籃今天吃。|另一籃留到冬天。

pages.title: Dry the fruit
lines: An adult cuts the fruit.
The children spread safe slices on a tray.
pages.translation: 大人切水果。|孩子們把安全的果片排在托盤上。

pages.title: Fill the jars
lines: The neighbors put food into clean jars.
They close each lid.
pages.translation: 鄰居們把食物裝進乾淨的罐子。|鄰居們蓋好每個罐蓋。

pages.title: Shelves for winter
lines: Gail places a light jar on a low shelf.
The walkway stays clear.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把輕罐子放在低架上。|走道保持暢通。

pages.title: Check the house
lines: Adults check the door and windows.
Gail notices a draft.
pages.translation: 大人檢查門窗。|瑜瑜注意到有冷風吹進來。

pages.title: Wood for warmth
lines: Adults carry and stack dry firewood.
Gail stays away from the fire.
pages.translation: 大人搬來乾木柴並疊好。|瑜瑜遠離火源。

pages.title: An empty shelf
lines: Gail sees an empty shelf next door.
She tells the other neighbors.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜看到隔壁空空的架子。|她告訴其他鄰居。

pages.title: Share the harvest
lines: Neighbors bring fruit and jars.
The older neighbor thanks them.
pages.translation: 鄰居們帶來水果和罐子。|年長鄰居謝謝他們。

pages.title: One last check
lines: Gail checks the food, doors, and path.
Everything is ready.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜檢查食物、門和道路。|一切都準備好了。

pages.title: The first flake
lines: A first snowflake lands on Gail’s hand.
The stone road is still clear.
pages.translation: 第一片雪花落在瑜瑜手上。|石路仍然暢通。

pages.title: Ready together
lines: Neighbors gather indoors with food.
No one is forgotten.
pages.translation: 鄰居們帶著食物在室內相聚。|沒有人被遺忘。

pages.title: A promise to return
lines: Gail is back in her bedroom.
The snowflake stays by the window.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜回到臥室。|雪花留在窗邊。

pages.title: A snowflake at the window
lines: On an autumn evening, a single snowflake drifts past Gail’s starry window and rests on its ledge.
She watches it without reaching out.
pages.translation: 秋天的傍晚，唯一的一片雪花飄過瑜瑜的星星窗戶，停在窗沿。|她靜靜看著，沒有立刻伸手。

pages.title: Before winter
lines: After the snowflake becomes still, its light opens a doorway.
Beyond it lies a familiar-looking town in the last warm days before winter, with no snow on the road.
pages.translation: 雪花停穩後，亮光打開一道門。|門外是冬天前最後幾個暖日的小鎮，路上還沒有積雪。

pages.title: The last warm days
lines: At the bell tower, Gail sees neighbors carrying baskets and closing open crates.
Everyone is preparing for cold weather before the first real snowfall.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜在鐘塔旁看見鄰居們搬運籃子、收好木箱。|大家在第一場真正的雪到來前，為寒冷天氣作準備。

pages.title: A full orchard
lines: Gail and her new friend walk through the farm orchard to see which fruit is ready.
Ripe apples and grapes still hang from the branches and vines.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜與新朋友走進小鎮果園，查看哪些水果成熟了。|蘋果與葡萄仍掛在枝頭和藤上。

pages.title: Pick with care
lines: Gail picks fruit that is ripe and lets the small green apples stay on the tree.
Her friend shows her how to lower each apple gently into the basket.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜只摘成熟的果子，把還小的青蘋果留在樹上。|朋友教她把蘋果輕輕放進籃子。

pages.title: Bring in the crop
lines: Before the weather turns, a farmer loads the final crop onto a wooden cart.
Gail and her friend walk beside it as the food goes to the storehouse, where the adults will store it.
pages.translation: 天氣轉變前，農夫把最後一批作物裝上木車。|瑜瑜與朋友走在旁邊，看食物運往倉房。

pages.title: Grapes for the adults
lines: Gail and her friend gather and collect whole bunches of grapes, then pass the baskets to the adults.
The grown-ups will take them into the separate wine-making area.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜和朋友採下完整的一串串葡萄，將籃子交給大人。|大人會帶葡萄去分開的釀酒工作區。

pages.title: Press and seal
lines: Inside the workshop, the grown-ups press grapes and seal a wine barrel in their work area.
At the safe food table, Gail presses a small bowl of grapes for her own juice.
pages.translation: 在工作坊裡，大人在自己的工作區壓葡萄、封好酒桶。|瑜瑜則在安全的食物桌上，把少量葡萄壓成自己的果汁。

pages.title: Eat now or save?
lines: Back at the food table, Gail helps sort fresh fruit into two baskets: some to eat now and some to save for the cold weeks ahead.
pages.translation: 回到食物桌前，瑜瑜把新鮮水果分進兩個籃子：一些今天吃，一些留給接下來寒冷的日子。

pages.title: Dry the fruit
lines: An adult carefully cuts the apples into thin pieces.
Gail and her friend lay the ready slices in neat rows so they can dry for winter.
pages.translation: 大人小心把蘋果切成薄片。|瑜瑜和朋友把已切好的果片整齊排開，準備曬乾留到冬天。

pages.title: Fill the jars
lines: The neighbors fill clean jars with preserved food and seal each one carefully.
Gail checks that every closed jar can stand steady on the table.
pages.translation: 鄰居們把保存的食物放入乾淨的罐子，小心封好。|瑜瑜確認每個罐子都能穩穩站在桌上。

pages.title: Shelves for winter
lines: Gail carries only the light jars to a low shelf and leaves room between them.
No box blocks the walkway, so people can reach the food supply safely.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜只搬輕罐子到低架，罐與罐間留空。|沒有箱子擋住走道，大家能安全拿取物資。

pages.title: Check the house
lines: At one house, adults prepare for the cold by examining the door and window.
Gail points out a small gap where chilly air can enter.
pages.translation: 在一棟屋裡，大人在寒冷來臨前檢查門窗。|瑜瑜指出一處會讓冷風鑽進來的小縫。

pages.title: Wood for warmth
lines: The adults put dry wood in a safe place near the house and handle the fireplace themselves.
Gail helps by pointing to a fallen small piece from a safe distance.
pages.translation: 大人把乾柴收在屋旁安全處，也由他們處理壁爐。|瑜瑜保持距離，指出一塊掉落的小木片。

pages.title: An empty shelf
lines: When Gail visits the older neighbor, she notices that the food shelf is nearly empty.
She asks whether more food from the town supply would help before making a plan.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜探訪年長鄰居時，看見食物架幾乎空了。|她先問對方是否需要補充物資，才開始想辦法。

pages.title: Share the harvest
lines: The neighbors offer some of the harvest they prepared together.
They bring fruit and sealed jars to the older woman, making sure her winter shelf has enough food too.
pages.translation: 鄰居們拿出大家一起準備的收成。|他們送去水果和封好的罐子，讓年長鄰居的冬天食物架也足夠。

pages.title: One last check
lines: Before dusk, the townspeople make one last round: food is stored, doors are secure, and the route to the older neighbor’s home is clear.
pages.translation: 黃昏前，鎮民最後巡看一次：食物已收好、門窗安全、通往年長鄰居家的路也暢通。

pages.title: The first flake
lines: As Gail raises her hand, the first snowflake lands on her palm.
The roofs, bridge, and stone road remain bare; the town is ready before the snow begins.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜舉起手，第一片雪花落在掌心。|屋頂、橋和石路還沒有積雪；小鎮已在下雪前準備好。

pages.title: Ready together
lines: The families go inside to warm rooms, where saved food waits on the shelves.
The older neighbor joins them, and everyone knows they have prepared together.
pages.translation: 家家戶戶回到溫暖室內，架上有保存好的食物。|年長鄰居也加入，大家知道自己是一起準備好的。

pages.title: A promise to return
lines: Gail returns to her familiar room, leaving the quiet snowflake by the window.
She hopes to visit the town again and see how everyone helps after the snow.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜回到熟悉的房間，把安靜的雪花留在窗邊。|她期待下雪後再探訪小鎮，看大家如何互相幫忙。

chinese: 秋天的傍晚，唯一的一片雪花飄過瑜瑜的星星窗戶，停在窗沿。
她靜靜看著，沒有立刻伸手。
雪花停穩後，亮光打開一道門。
門外是冬天前最後幾個暖日的小鎮，路上還沒有積雪。
瑜瑜在鐘塔旁看見鄰居們搬運籃子、收好木箱。
大家在第一場真正的雪到來前，為寒冷天氣作準備。
瑜瑜與新朋友走進小鎮果園，查看哪些水果成熟了。
蘋果與葡萄仍掛在枝頭和藤上。
瑜瑜只摘成熟的果子，把還小的青蘋果留在樹上。
朋友教她把蘋果輕輕放進籃子。
天氣轉變前，農夫把最後一批作物裝上木車。
瑜瑜與朋友走在旁邊，看食物運往倉房。
瑜瑜和朋友採下完整的一串串葡萄，將籃子交給大人。
大人會帶葡萄去分開的釀酒工作區。
在工作坊裡，大人在自己的工作區壓葡萄、封好酒桶。
瑜瑜則在安全的食物桌上，把少量葡萄壓成自己的果汁。
回到食物桌前，瑜瑜把新鮮水果分進兩個籃子：一些今天吃，一些留給接下來寒冷的日子。
大人小心把蘋果切成薄片。
瑜瑜和朋友把已切好的果片整齊排開，準備曬乾留到冬天。
鄰居們把保存的食物放入乾淨的罐子，小心封好。
瑜瑜確認每個罐子都能穩穩站在桌上。
瑜瑜只搬輕罐子到低架，罐與罐間留空。
沒有箱子擋住走道，大家能安全拿取物資。
在一棟屋裡，大人在寒冷來臨前檢查門窗。
瑜瑜指出一處會讓冷風鑽進來的小縫。
大人把乾柴收在屋旁安全處，也由他們處理壁爐。
瑜瑜保持距離，指出一塊掉落的小木片。
瑜瑜探訪年長鄰居時，看見食物架幾乎空了。
她先問對方是否需要補充物資，才開始想辦法。
鄰居們拿出大家一起準備的收成。
他們送去水果和封好的罐子，讓年長鄰居的冬天食物架也足夠。
黃昏前，鎮民最後巡看一次：食物已收好、門窗安全、通往年長鄰居家的路也暢通。
瑜瑜舉起手，第一片雪花落在掌心。
屋頂、橋和石路還沒有積雪；小鎮已在下雪前準備好。
家家戶戶回到溫暖室內，架上有保存好的食物。
年長鄰居也加入，大家知道自己是一起準備好的。
瑜瑜回到熟悉的房間，把安靜的雪花留在窗邊。
她期待下雪後再探訪小鎮，看大家如何互相幫忙。
